subject: ClearPath trial fit: deployment mode question + PoC responsibilities
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofiam@clearpathhealth.com>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: ClearPath trial fit: deployment mode question + PoC responsibilities

Hi Sofia / Ben —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + a couple of asks so we can lock the PoC plan:

Recap
- Primary goal: validate inference latency at 95th percentile under ClearPath peak windows and confirm cost per 1K user queries for your triage workflow.
- Key constraints you called out: PHI data residency in us-east-1, RBC audit logging, and the ability to run a short on-prem dry-run if network policies block direct internet egress.
- Expected peak load for the pilot: ~600–900 requests/minute during the 30-minute triage surge (burst tolerant) and typical steady-state ~60 rpm.

Decision area we need from you by EOD Thu, Jan 21
- Preferred deployment mode for the PoC: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated Capacity (reserved GPUs), or Private VPC / on-prem (for PHI). The PoC scope and timeline shift materially with that choice.

Proposed PoC (3-week default if Hosted / Dedicated; 5-week if Private VPC/on-prem)
1) Week 0: Kickoff — exchange network diagram + test accounts (owner: ClearPath / contact: Ben)
2) Week 1: Integration + synthetic load runs — validate latency and KV caching behavior (owner: Redwood - Karthik)
3) Week 2: Real-data smoke (sanitized subset) + cost telemetry — measure token/unit economics (owner: ClearPath / Sofia)
4) Week 3: Evaluation & next-steps: pass/fail against success criteria; decision to proceed to production rollout.

Success criteria (baseline — will be finalized in attachment)
- 95th PCTL latency <= 350ms for interactive prompts under expected peak (or acceptable alternative we agree)
- Error rate < 0.5% across 100k tokens
- Detailed cost projection for 100k/month queries within agreed budget envelope
- Network audit / logging available for review (if Private VPC)

Attachments: ClearPath_PoC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx (xlsx) — I dropped a template with the KPI cells filled from today's notes. Also included a network-diagram-template.pdf for your infra team.

Next steps
- Sofia/Ben: confirm preferred deployment mode and who from your infra/security team we loop in for the network diagram.
- Karthik / Camila: I think Karthik should lead the perf validation and Camila will own the onboarding playbook.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min alignment call once you confirm mode.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
[vivek@redwoodinference.com]

Subject: Re: ClearPath trial fit: deployment mode question + PoC responsibilities

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the template. Two quick clarifications from our side:

1) Data residency and compliance: PHI will need to remain inside our VPC in us-east-1 for audit reasons. If Hosted API can meet that with a VPC peering / private link setup and KMS integration, that would be ideal. Otherwise we will need Dedicated Capacity with VPC peering.
2) On-prem dry-run: we may need to run a short dry-run in our staging colo (air-gapped) to prove we can handle the model artifacts and KV cache. If Redwood supports an on-prem dry-run during the PoC (no outbound telemetry), that's a strong plus.

We prefer to explore Hosted with PrivateLink first; if that can't meet the audit controls we'll flip to Dedicated. Can you confirm whether Redwood's Hosted API supports PrivateLink & KMS? Also please call out any additional lead time for Dedicated / Private deployments.

I'll loop in our infra lead (Ben) to provide the network diagram next week.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Morales
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearPath Health

Sofia / Vivek / Ben —

Quick follow from our infra/ops perspective:

1) Hosted API + PrivateLink + customer-managed KMS is supported. That path typically gives you Redwood-managed runtime with private network connectivity and customer keys; lead time ~2 weeks to provision and validate with your infra team.
2) Dedicated Capacity (reserved GPUs in a customer-isolated pool) is a good middle ground if you want predictable throughput and no shared tenancy; lead time ~3–4 weeks for capacity reservation + network setup.
3) Private on-prem package is available but requires a short planning phase and an on-site dry-run; lead time ~6–8 weeks depending on artifact transfer windows.

For the PoC, here's a slightly adapted timeline if you opt for Hosted+PrivateLink:
- Week A (provisioning): private link setup + KMS integration (owners: Ben + Karthik)
- Week B (integration): test harness, perf scripts, and KV caching checks (owner: Karthik)
- Week C (validation): controlled smoke and real-data sample with capture of audit logs (owner: Sofia + Camila)

I attached a short checklist for things we will need to get the PrivateLink path green: VPC CIDR ranges, allowed ports for peering, KMS key ARN, and any proxy restrictions.

If you want, I can create a canary run plan that ramps to your 95th PCTL goal in 30-minute bursts so we can measure transient tail latency.

Regards,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Vivek / Karthik / Camila —

Thanks for the details and the checklist. We've reviewed internally:
- We will proceed with Hosted API + PrivateLink + customer KMS for the PoC. That keeps Redwood managed while giving us the audit controls.
- I'll share our network diagram (VPC CIDRs + allowed ports) by EOD Wednesday Jan 21.
- We accept the 3-week PoC timeline under that path. Please share the canary run plan and the exact test script so we can align load generators.

Sofia and I will be the PoC owners from ClearPath. Karthik, please confirm who on your side will run the perf scripts and what credentials we need for the test harness.

Regards,
Ben
